name: Grain
one_liner: Meeting recorder with transcripts, AI notes, recordings, and clips for your workspace.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token for one user, Workspace Access Token for workspace-wide server use (admin only), and OAuth2 for integrations distributed to other Grain users.
access_notes: Personal Access Token is generated in Account settings, Integrations, Personal API, and is available on every plan including Free. Workspace tokens need a workspace admin on Business or Enterprise.

buildability.rationale: Documented API with webhooks and a 300 requests/minute limit. Personal tokens are self-serve on every plan, but workspace-wide tokens need admin access on Business or Enterprise. No sandbox, so tests run against a live workspace.

identity.quote: The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically.

auth.quote: Personal Access Token (PAT): grants access on behalf of a single user.
OAuth2: the standard flow for building integrations to be used by any Grain user.

access.quote: Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free.
Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans.

sandbox.quote: No sandbox is available at this time.

api_surface.quote: The API allows 300 requests per minute per token.
Learn how to use the GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK to extend Grain.
Webhooks let Grain push data to your system when events occur, rather than requiring you to poll for changes.

mcp.quote: Grain's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server gives AI assistants direct access to your meetings, transcripts, AI notes, and workspace data.

buildability.quote: Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.

needs_human_reason: The developer reference (developers.grain.com) is not in the cached pages, so endpoint count, pagination, OAuth scopes and app review are unknown. The GraphQL style comes from a single grain.com/contact line. Search results also named unrelated products called Grain.
